header.tagline: A tool decision hub for China-based global sellers
header.search: Search tools, categories, markets, and guides

home.eyebrow: Navigation and operating references for global growth teams
home.title: Help China-based teams choose the right platforms, tools, and service partners faster
home.description: Built around cross-border commerce, independent sites, logistics, payment, compliance, and AI tooling with search-friendly and scalable content.
home.audienceDescription: Built for China-based sellers, independent site teams, trading companies, and operators evaluating platforms, tools, and service partners.
home.entryDescription: Enter by problem, market, platform, or method to narrow the right resource set faster.

categories.title: Start by problem
categories.description: If you already know you need logistics, payment, storefront, sourcing, AI, or compliance resources, begin with categories.

markets.title: Start by market
markets.description: If you focus on the US, Europe, the UK, or Southeast Asia, compare the operational differences by region first.

platforms.title: Start by platform
platforms.description: If your work is centered on Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, or owned channels, browse by platform context.

guides.title: Start by method
guides.description: If you are still building your understanding, start with editorial guides to learn playbooks and common questions.

home.submissionDescription: Submit valuable tools, sites, or service providers for review and possible inclusion in the directory.
home.sponsorDescription: Qualified service providers can explore promotional placements through the submission channel.

submit.title: Submit a new site
submit.description: After submission, the editorial team reviews the entry, refines its classification, and publishes suitable listings.
process: Submit a site with contact details
Run duplicate checks and basic validation
Editors enrich category, market, and summary
Merge the content change and publish automatically
submit.securityNotice: Complete the security check before submitting to reduce spam.
submit.requiredHint: Fields marked with * are required. Make sure the site is reachable and relevant to global trade workflows.
submit.reviewNotice: Submissions are reviewed manually to confirm relevance, avoid duplicates, and maintain listing quality.

placeholders.siteName: Example: ERP tool, logistics service, sourcing platform
placeholders.description: Explain what the site does, who it serves, and why it is useful for China-based global teams.
placeholders.contactDetails: Email, WeChat, Telegram, or another reliable contact method
placeholders.notes: Optional details such as target markets, language support, or partnership notes.

hints.categories: Multi-select is supported and helps editors classify the submission faster.
hints.markets: Tag the regions you mainly serve if the site is market-specific.
hints.platforms: Select Amazon, Shopify, owned channels, or other relevant platform contexts.

feedback.successTitle: Submission added to the review queue
feedback.successDescription: A GitHub Issue was created for editorial review and follow-up publishing work.
feedback.duplicateTitle: This site appears to be already indexed
feedback.duplicateDescription: The domain matches an existing listing, so no new submission issue was created.
feedback.errorDescription: The site could not create a GitHub Issue right now. Please try again later.
feedback.validationError: The submission did not pass basic validation. Please review the URL, description, and contact details.
feedback.configError: The submission service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
feedback.spamError: The submission did not pass the anti-spam check. Refresh and try again.
feedback.turnstileRequired: Complete the security check before submitting the site.
feedback.turnstileFailed: The security check failed or expired. Please complete it again and retry.

footer.description: Silkroads Trade helps China-based teams evaluate tools, markets, and service providers for global growth.
